thread.topic: Free Credits in the Dream Steam Group

posts.subject: Free Credits in the Dream Steam Group
posts.bodyHtml:
Hey,


we've made an update to all our servers.


To raise awareness for our Dream Steam Group, we have introduced this new feature.
From now on, every user in our Steam Group will recieve one (1) additional credit per minute.


That means, if you're a member of the Dream Steam Group, you will recieve 3 instead of 2 credits per minute.



How do I join the group?
Just follow this link here and press the green "Join Group" button in the top right corner. Don't forget to invite your friends as well.


--> http://steamcommunity.com/groups/Dreamx3 <--


If you did everything correct, you should see this message ingame once every minute.
[Bild]



Thank you for being a part of the Dream Community.
